---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_rows(genre, sep = "\\s*,\\s*")
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies, aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, boundary = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Films with a score:", sum(!is.na(movies$tomatoMeter))),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_gap |>
  select(title, audienceScore, tomatoMeter, gap) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)
```
